summary:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

XO (Xen Orchestra) is a solution to visualize, manage, backup and delegate your XCP-ng (or XenServer) infrastructure. Prior to 6.9.2 and 6.10.1, REST cookie parsing turns authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D into {}. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats {} as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated /rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens route then returns reusable login token IDs. This vulnerability is actively exploited in the wild. This vulnerability is fixed in 6.9.2 and 6.10.1.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch torch_save_to_dcp Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the checkpoint format conversion utilities. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32834.

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains an unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability in the report module (openimis-be-report_py) where the /api/report/reportbro/preview endpoint evaluates printIf expressions server-side using simpleeval with an insufficient name-prefix blocklist. An attacker can craft an expression that reaches sys.modules['os'] via datetime.sys to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root, and can also exploit the same endpoint's key parameter for unauthenticated arbitrary file read, enabling full host compromise including exposure of database credentials and JWT signing keys.

An issue was found in Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below. A remote code/command injection vulnerability was discovered in one of the example DAGs shipped with Airflow which would allow any authenticated user to run arbitrary commands as the user running airflow worker/scheduler (depending on the executor in use). If you already have examples disabled by setting load_examples=False in the config then you are not vulnerable.

audio-separator before 0.47.2 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying malicious Demucs .th model files loaded via torch.load with weights_only=False. Local users writing to the shared /tmp/audio-separator-models/ default directory, or attackers controlling unverified model download sources, can execute code when victims run Demucs separation.

paramz through 0.10.0 contains an insecure deserialization vulnerability that allows attackers to execute code by supplying crafted model files to paramz.load(), which calls pickle.load() without restrictions. Attackers can embed objects whose __reduce__ method returns callables like exec or os.system in shared paramz or GPy model files to run code with the victim's privileges.

Camunda 8.8.0 before 8.8.47, 8.9.0 before 8.9.29, 8.10.0 before 8.10.10, and 8.11.0-alpha1 contain an insecure deserialization vulnerability in the persistent web session feature, which stores session attributes as Java-serialized data in secondary storage and deserializes them via an ObjectInputStream without an ObjectInputFilter. Attackers with write access to the web session index, such as an unauthenticated Elasticsearch cluster deployed via Camunda's docker-compose files, can plant a crafted serialized object and trigger deserialization by presenting a matching session cookie, which combined with a gadget chain like the bundled Commons Collections 3.1-RC1 library can lead to code execution as the Camunda service account.

The previous default setting for Airflow's Experimental API was to allow all API requests without authentication, but this poses security risks to users who miss this fact. From Airflow 1.10.11 the default has been changed to deny all requests by default and is documented at https://airflow.apache.org/docs/1.10.11/security.html#api-authentication. Note this change fixes it for new installs but existing users need to change their config to default `[api]auth_backend = airflow.api.auth.backend.deny_all` as mentioned in the Updating Guide: https://github.com/apache/airflow/blob/1.10.11/UPDATING.md#experimental-api-will-deny-all-request-by-default

Improper Neutralization of Directives in Dynamically Evaluated Code ('Eval Injection') in the HWBridge custom methods command dispatcher (lib/rex/post/hwbridge/ui/console/command_dispatcher/custom_methods.rb) in Rapid7 Metasploit Framework versions prior to 6.5.10 on all platforms allows a malicious or compromised hardware bridge to execute arbitrary code in the msfconsole process via a crafted method_name returned by the /custom_methods endpoint. The injected code runs automatically when the operator connects to the bridge, without the operator invoking any custom command.

Deserialization of untrusted data in double-submit cookie vs. form field validation in Idunno.AntiCsrf versions through 0.9.1 Beta on ASP.NET allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute code via object injection

A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind command injection attack due to insufficient parameter sanitization. A successful exploit could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the context of the system. This is MTLVULN-1864.

The variable import endpoint was not protected by authentication in Airflow >=2.0.0, <2.1.3. This allowed unauthenticated users to hit that endpoint to add/modify Airflow variables used in DAGs, potentially resulting in a denial of service, information disclosure or remote code execution. This issue affects Apache Airflow >=2.0.0, <2.1.3.

An Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner in Juniper Networks Session Smart Conductor allows a remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root via a specially crafted salt minion ID.

MiniDVBLinux 5.4 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the SVDRP protocol that allows remote attackers to send commands to manipulate TV systems. Attackers can send crafted SVDRP commands through the svdrpsend.sh script to execute messages and potentially control the video disk recorder remotely.

Joomla Extension - valorapps.com - Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution in Easy File Uploader < 2.9.7 - An unauthenticated remote attacker can upload a PHP-executable file to the Joomla web root with a single multipart POST request, requiring no credentials and no CSRF token.

A out-of-bounds read vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS 8.0.0 through 8.0.2, FortiOS 7.6.0 through 7.6.8, FortiOS 7.4.0 through 7.4.13, FortiOS 7.2 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code or command via crafted packets.

An issue was found in Apache Airflow versions 1.10.10 and below. When using CeleryExecutor, if an attack can connect to the broker (Redis, RabbitMQ) directly, it was possible to insert a malicious payload directly to the broker which could lead to a deserialization attack (and thus remote code execution) on the Worker.

MiniDVBLinux 5.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows remote attackers to change the root password without authentication. Attackers can send crafted POST requests to the system setup endpoint with modified SYSTEM_PASSWORD parameters to reset root credentials.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch load_compiled_function Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the load_compiled_function function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32603.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch load_state_dict_from_url Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the load_state_dict_from_url function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32601.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch FileSystemReader Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation.

The specific flaw exists within the FileSystemReader class. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32600.

DeepSpeed _get_zero_stage Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of DeepSpeed. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of checkpoint data. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-29242.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch AOTIModelPackageLoader Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation.

The specific flaw exists within the AOTIModelPackageLoader. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-32262.

Dell Secure Connect Gateway (SCG) Virtual Edition, versions prior to 5.36.00.16, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability. An attacker with local access to the appliance could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution and privilege escalation, resulting in complete compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the appliance.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch AOTIModelPackageLoader  Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page or open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the AOTInductor model package loader. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-33055.

Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal') vulnerability in WP Media WP Rocket wp-rocket allows Path Traversal.This issue affects WP Rocket: from n/a before 3.24.2.

Electerm before 5.9.0 contains an origin validation vulnerability in the MCP Server widget that allows remote attackers to execute commands by bypassing Host and Origin checks through DNS rebinding. Attackers can lure users to a page that rebinds to 127.0.0.1 and calls unauthenticated MCP tools on port 30837 to run OS commands locally and on open SSH sessions.

Webmin through 2.670 contains an improper certificate validation vulnerability in the http_download function of web-lib-funcs.pl that skips TLS chain and hostname verification. Man-in-the-middle attackers can present any certificate and substitute downloaded modules, themes, or catalog content, leading to root code execution or injected HTML.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the Perl Modules (cpan) module, which downloads CPAN indexes and module archives over plaintext HTTP without checksum or signature verification. On-path network attackers can answer the outbound fetch while an administrator installs a CPAN module, supplying a malicious Makefile.PL that cpan/download.cgi runs as root before confirmation.

Webmin through 2.670 contains a missing authentication vulnerability in fastrpc.cgi that allows unauthenticated network peers to connect to tcpwrite and tcpread file-transfer listeners without session checks. Attackers can race to connect to the predictable transfer port during cluster operations to steal transferred files or replace staged packages, achieving root code execution.

build-git-clone before 1.0.4 contains an OS command injection vulnerability in the clone() function that allows attackers to execute commands by supplying crafted repository URLs. Attackers can embed shell metacharacters such as ; or $() in the url argument, which is concatenated into a sh -c command, to execute operating system commands with Node.js process privileges.

markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass URL validation by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Attackers can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown through prompt injection to fetch loopback services, internal hosts, and cloud metadata endpoints.

A security flaw has been discovered in Volans NGFW Next-Generation Firewall r5.1. The affected element is an unknown function of the file include/sqlite3.inc of the component Web Management Interface. Performing a manipulation results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

@irrelon/path 6.2.2 before 7.0.3 contains a prototype pollution vulnerability in merge() and mergeImmutable() that allows remote attackers to modify Object.prototype by supplying __proto__ keys. Attackers can pass untrusted JSON containing __proto__ or constructor.prototype payloads to merged objects, causing property injection, authorization bypass, or denial of service.

OpenRemote core before 1.34.0 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in UserAssetProvisioningMQTTHandler that allows unauthenticated attackers to impersonate provisioned devices without proof of private key possession. Attackers can publish a known device's public certificate to the provisioning request topic, authenticating their anonymous MQTT connection as the device's service account to read and modify assets.

The Live Auction Cockpit in SAP Supplier Relationship Management (SRM) uses a deprecated java applet component, which allows an unauthenticated attacker to send malicious payload request in a specific encoding format. The servlet will then decode this malicious request which will result in deserialization of data in the application leading to execution of arbitrary OS command on target as SAP Administrator. This vulnerability has High impact on confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the application.

ChargePoint Home Flex dwnldlogsm tar Command Injection Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the tar function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29057.

GNU Inetutils FTP Client File Retrieval Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GNU Inetutils FTP Client. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must interact with a malicious FTP server.

The specific flaw exists within the processing of filenames. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current user. Was ZDI-CAN-29119.

Missing Authentication for Critical Function in Apache Texera (incubating).



The Python virtual environment (PVE) management endpoints of a computing unit are not authenticated by the application itself. In the local JVM and single-node Docker Compose deployments, which place no authenticating gateway in front of the services, these endpoints are reachable without credentials. The Kubernetes deployment gates them at the gateway, so only the Kubernetes deployment provides the full security model described in SECURITY.md.



This issue affects Apache Texera (incubating): from 1.1.0 through 1.2.0.



Users are recommended to use the Kubernetes deployment, which enforces the full security model, and to upgrade to 1.3.0-incubating, which documents that the local JVM and single-node Docker Compose deployments do not provide the full security model and should only be used by trusted users.

asar-py before 0.1.4 contains a path traversal vulnerability in AsarArchive.extract() and extract_archive() that allows attackers to write files outside the destination directory via crafted archive headers. Attackers can supply a .asar archive with '..' path components or malicious symlink targets to write files such as usercustomize.py, leading to code execution.

ChargePoint Home Flex uploadsm filetype Link Following Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of the filetype parameter passed to the uploadsm endpoint. By creating a symbolic link, an attacker can abuse the service to write an arbitrary file. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29096.

A remote code execution vulnerability was found in libaom, the reference AV1 codec implementation. Insufficient bounds validation in the AV1 encoder's SVC (Scalable Video Coding) layer ID control allows an attacker to supply crafted video frame pixels that overlap with internal encoder layer context structures. In fork-based video processing services, an attacker can use this to hijack the cyclic refresh map pointer, brute-force the process base address via a crash oracle, and redirect control flow to achieve arbitrary command execution. Exploitation requires the target service to use libaom with SVC encoding enabled and accept attacker-supplied video frames.

Optimizely Web Experimentation before 2026-11-17 mishandles the account signup flow, leading to presence of attacker-controlled code in the projectJS (aka Project JavaScript) field of certain cdn.optimizely.com assets.
Improper Authentication vulnerability in Danfoss AKSM8xxA Series.This issue affects Danfoss AK-SM 8xxA Series prior to version 4.2

A Java deserialisation vulnerability has been discovered in Jaspersoft Library. Improper handling of externally supplied data may allow attackers to execute arbitrary code remotely on systems that use the affected library

Cockpit's remote login feature passes user-supplied hostnames and usernames from the web interface to the SSH client without validation or sanitization. An attacker with network access to the Cockpit web service can craft a single HTTP request to the login endpoint that injects malicious SSH options or shell commands, achieving code execution on the Cockpit host without valid credentials. The injection occurs during the authentication flow before any credential verification takes place, meaning no login is required to exploit the vulnerability.

A Code Injection and Missing Authentication vulnerability in Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) versions 1.7.0 (and 2.0.0a1) through 1.28.1 (and 2.0.0a2) on Python (OSS), Cloud Run, and GKE allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server hosting the ADK instance.

This vulnerability was patched in versions 1.28.1 and 2.0.0a2.


Customers need to redeploy the upgraded ADK to their production environments. In addition, if they are running ADK Web locally, they also need to upgrade their local instance.
In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.2, 2026.1.4, 2025.11.8 remote code execution was possible via external pull requests

In MediaFocusFidlImpl of media_focus_fidl_impl.cc, there is a possible use after free due to a race condition. This could lead to remote code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In HandleRxPdu of channel.cc, there is a possible use after free due to the channel being destroyed while it is still processing a received frame. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

In LogicalLink::SignalError of logical_link.cc, there is a possible use after free due to an error callback that can synchronously destroy the link while its channels are still being iterated. This could lead to remote (proximal/adjacent) code execution with no additional execution privileges needed. User interaction is not needed for exploitation.

XML::Sig versions before 0.74 for Perl allow code execution via a document's Algorithm attribute that verify resolves to a function name and calls.

The text after the last `#` in the DigestMethod and SignatureMethod Algorithm attributes is looked up with Digest::SHA->can. That returns a code reference for any fully qualified function name, Perl builtins in the CORE namespace included. The digest function is called on the canonical form of the referenced element, so the document picks both the function and its argument.

An attacker who can submit a signed document can run a command as the verifying process.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch PT2 File Parsing Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch. Interaction with this library is required to exploit this vulnerability but attack vectors may vary depending on the implementation.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of PT2 files. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute Python code. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32602.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Paul Shield Security wp-simple-firewall allows Cross Site Request Forgery.This issue affects Shield Security: from n/a through 22.3.4.

DeepSeek-Reasonix before 2.53.0 contains a command execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run commands without user approval because the shellsafe classifier treats git blame and git whatchanged as read-only. Attackers can plant a diff textconv driver in .gitattributes and .git/config so that git blame, triggered via prompt injection or routine use, executes attacker-chosen commands with the user's privileges, exposing stored provider API keys and session history.

NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC control interface to any local process without authentication. On Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, the interface is a Unix domain socket that is accessible to all local users, allowing any of them to control the daemon. An attacker with a low-privilege account can read or modify privileged VPN and daemon settings, disconnect or hijack the NetBird peer, and gain an unauthenticated root shell via the built-in SSH server. This issue is fixed in version 0.76.0.

Improper input validation in Variations in Google Chrome prior to 158.0.8127.88 allowed a remote attacker to potentially execute arbitrary code outside the sandbox via a crafted HTML page. (Chromium security severity: Critical)

A vulnerability was detected in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This affects an unknown part of the file /cgi-bin/dashboard/ajax_chart_dump. The manipulation of the argument isntmeye results in os command injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A flaw was found in the Samba printing subsystem. Samba passes the client-controlled job description string to the command configured with the "print command" setting via the "%J"
substitution character without escaping shell meta characters. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability by sending a specially crafted print job description that contains unescaped shell characters. This could lead to remote code execution on the affected system.

PyTorch Foundation PyTorch PT2 File Parsing Exposed Dangerous Method Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of PyTorch Foundation PyTorch. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must open a malicious file.

The specific flaw exists within the parsing of PT2 archive files. The issue results from an exposed dangerous function. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the current process. Was ZDI-CAN-32653.

A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

A use-after-free vulnerability was found in drivers/nvme/target/tcp.c` in `nvmet_tcp_free_crypto` due to a logical bug in the NVMe/TCP subsystem in the Linux kernel. This issue may allow a malicious user to cause a use-after-free and double-free problem, which may permit remote code execution or lead to local privilege escalation.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Frisbii Frisbii Pay reepay-checkout-gateway allows Object Injection.This issue affects Frisbii Pay: from n/a before 1.8.20.

When sftpEnabled=true (the default configuration in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg), the SSH server exposes the karaf.base directory tree through the MINA SSHD SFTP subsystem and SCP command factory without verifying the authenticated user's roles beyond the initial sshRole login check. Consequently, an authenticated user with only low-privileged roles (such as viewer and ssh) can read sensitive configuration and key files (including etc/users.properties and etc/host.key) or write arbitrary bundles/configurations into monitored directories (such as deploy/ or etc/), leading to privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution.


Apache Karaf 4.4.13 and 4.5.0 introduce the sftpRole configuration property in org.apache.karaf.shell (defaulting to admin) and enforce role-based access control on SFTP subsystem creation, SCP command execution, and virtual filesystem access.

Mitigation / WorkaroundUsers are recommended to upgrade to Apache Karaf 4.4.13 or 4.5.0.




On earlier versions where SFTP/SCP access is not required, set sftpEnabled=false in etc/org.apache.karaf.shell.cfg and restart the SSH server bundle (or Karaf instance).

openIMIS before 2026-10 contains a remote code execution vulnerability in the report module's overrideReport GraphQL mutation, which stores submitted report definitions without proper validation before rendering them with the simpleeval expression evaluator. An attacker holding only limited report add, edit, or query privileges can craft a printIf expression that leverages the datetime module to reach os.system functions, bypassing the name-prefix blocklist to execute arbitrary operating-system commands as root whenever the malicious report is later rendered by any viewer, including administrators or scheduled jobs.

Comviva Revenue Plus (MobiLytix Customer Value Management) 3.0.0 contains an expression language injection vulnerability in the user administration module, where the POST /rp/manageUser endpoint handled by manageUsersAction evaluates the name of an arbitrary request parameter as a server-side Java EL expression before rendering the response. The only protection is a denylist of reflective method names, which does not cover constructor-based access to a JDK scripting engine, so authenticated low-privilege attackers can supply an EL expression as a parameter name to execute arbitrary operating system commands as the application server account. This product is no longer supported by the vendor; standard support ended on 2022-10-31 and extended support ended on 2023-10-31.

Handesk through 1.5 contains an unrestricted file upload vulnerability in Attachment::storeAttachmentFromRequest() that allows authenticated agents to upload files with arbitrary extensions by attaching them to ticket comments without extension, MIME type, or size validation. Attackers can upload a PHP file via POST /tickets/{ticket}/comments, which is stored under storage/app/public/attachments and served from /storage/attachments/, to achieve remote code execution as the web server user or serve malicious HTML/SVG content from the application origin.

An authentication bypass vulnerability exists in the web management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to gain unauthorized administrative access to the affected system, impacting the confidentiality and integrity of AirWave.

BusyBox versions 1.27.0 before 1.38.0, fixed in commit 42202bf, contain a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in the DHCPv6 client (udhcpc6) DNS_SERVERS option handler in networking/udhcp/d6_dhcpc.c that allows network-adjacent attackers to trigger memory corruption by sending a crafted DHCPv6 response with a malformed D6_OPT_DNS_SERVERS option. Attackers can exploit incorrect heap buffer allocation calculations in the option_to_env() function to cause denial of service or achieve arbitrary code execution on embedded systems without heap hardening.

A vulnerability was identified in Gladys Assistant up to 4.71.0. This affects an unknown function of the file gateway.downloadBackup.js of the component Backup Restore Endpoint. The manipulation of the argument file_url leads to os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. Upgrading to version 4.72.0 mitigates this issue. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

A flaw was found in gpgme. When processing crafted input, an early return following memory reallocation can leave internal buffer pointers referencing previously freed memory, resulting in a double-free condition during cleanup. A remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to corrupt process memory, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution or a Denial of Service (DoS) crash.

BeamNG.drive before 0.40.6 contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability because JIT-compiled LuaJIT traces omit FFI array bounds checks, letting untrusted Lua escape the sandbox. Attackers supplying a malicious mod can JIT-compile an FFI store loop, write out of range using a tostring() address leak, re-enable ffi.load, and run commands as the game user.

A vulnerability was found in CRI-O, where it can be requested to take a checkpoint archive of a container and later be asked to restore it. When it does that restoration, it attempts to restore the mounts from the restore archive instead of the pod request. As a result, the validations run on the pod spec, verifying that the pod has access to the mounts it specifies are not applicable to a restored container. This flaw allows a malicious user to trick CRI-O into restoring a pod that doesn't have access to host mounts. The user needs access to the kubelet or cri-o socket to call the restore endpoint and trigger the restore.

Ever Gauzy is an open source business management platform for ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, and project management. Prior to 111.44.2, getTracker in packages/core/src/lib/throttler/throttler-behind-proxy.guard.ts accepts CF-Connecting-IP without verifying that a trusted Cloudflare edge supplied it; when CF-Connecting-IP is absent, app.set('trust proxy', true) can let an attacker-controlled X-Forwarded-For value determine req.ip. In deployments where a trusted intermediary does not overwrite these headers, or where the firewall permits direct API access, varying the applicable header on repeated POST /auth/login requests gives an unauthenticated remote attacker a distinct throttle bucket for each attempt, so the five-attempts-per-60-seconds limit does not trigger and no account lockout, CAPTCHA, or exponential backoff limits password guessing. This issue is fixed in version 111.44.2.

A heap buffer overflow vulnerability was found in libaom, the reference AV1 codec implementation. A flaw in the AV1 encoder's Look-Ahead Processing (LAP) mode causes the first-pass stats ring buffer wrap-around guard to be bypassed when g_lag_in_frames is set to 1 or higher. This results in a 232-byte out-of-bounds write on every encoded frame after the second, corrupting adjacent heap objects. An attacker who can influence encoder configuration in a transcoding service or WebRTC session could exploit this to cause a denial of service (process crash) or potentially achieve code execution.
Authorization bypass through user-controlled key in Microsoft Clarity allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

A flaw was found in gst-plugins-base. A heap buffer overflow can be triggered when processing video buffers whose attached GstVideoMeta metadata declares plane strides and offsets that exceed the actual backing memory allocation. The metadata is not range-checked during deserialization, and the video frame mapping code does not verify that the declared plane geometry fits within the buffer before allowing consumers to read or write video data. A local attacker who controls the sending side of a GStreamer inter-process IPC pipeline can deliver a crafted buffer carrying fabricated strides, causing the receiving process to read or write beyond heap boundaries. Successful exploitation can cause a denial of service or potentially allow code execution within the affected process.

A flaw was found in JBoss marshalling. The Infinispan session replication path deserializes replicated session data via the JBoss Marshalling River unmarshaller with no class filtering — enabling RCE via deserialization gadget chains on every cluster node.

diffpy.structure before 3.5.1 contains a code execution vulnerability that allows attackers to run Python code by supplying crafted CIF symmetry operations passed to eval() in get_symop(). Attackers can embed expressions in the _space_group_symop_operation_xyz or _symmetry_equiv_pos_as_xyz loop to execute code with victim privileges when the CIF file is parsed locally.

ArcadeDB native-image server builds 26.8.1 before 26.11.1 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated clients to perform writes through read-only query paths by nesting statements in SELECT. Missing reflection metadata leaves SqlAstInspector with an empty AST, letting INSERT in projections or LET clauses persist via the query endpoint, MCP read-only mode, and HA follower routing.

KubeSphere 4.0.0 through 4.1.3 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the CertificateSigningRequest controller that allows attackers with permission to create CertificateSigningRequest objects to escalate privileges by exploiting automatic approval of requests carrying a kubesphere.io/username label without verifying the requester's identity or subject match. Attackers can submit a CertificateSigningRequest for the kubernetes.io/kube-apiserver-client signer with an arbitrary subject such as a platform administrator to obtain a cluster CA-signed client certificate, enabling authentication as the chosen identity and full cluster administrator privilege escalation.

ChargePoint Home Flex busybox Unnecessary Privileges Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the busybox binary. The issue results from the setuid flag being set. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29090.

RustDesk Client for Windows reg_recovery Missing Authorization Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of RustDesk Client for Windows. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the main IPC endpoint exposed by the RustDesk service. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-34805.

An arbitrary address write vulnerability was found in libaom, the reference AV1 codec implementation. A missing bounds check in the SVC (Scalable Video Coding) layer ID control function allows an attacker to inject an arbitrary pointer into the cyclic refresh map field via crafted image pixel values. The encoder then writes approximately 1,200 bytes at the attacker-controlled address. This is fully deterministic and does not require a separate information leak. An attacker who can supply frames to a network-facing libaom encoder with SVC enabled could exploit this for denial of service or potential code execution.

A security flaw has been discovered in Tenda RX3 16.03.13.11_multi. The impacted element is the function formSetSafeWanWebMan of the file /goform/SetRemoteWebCfg. The manipulation of the argument remoteIp results in command injection. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

A vulnerability was found in D-Link R32 1.10B02. This affects an unknown function of the file /usr/bin/httpd of the component flupl self Endpoint. Performing a manipulation of the argument fpath results in os command injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used.

psqlODBC frees memory that is still in use, frees it twice, or writes outside an application buffer in these cases:

- The clean-up the driver runs at commit and rollback sends queries of its own, and the reply to one of them can start the clean-up again while it is running. The nested run frees the rollback log, or the list of cursors and prepared statements to close, and the outer run uses and frees it again.
- The callback through which libpq delivers notices could run that clean-up, and close the connection, while libpq was still using the connection.
- Freeing a statement whose result holds several cursors (FetchRefcursors=1, or UseDeclareFetch=1) used the freed first result while the later cursors were closed.
- With UseDeclareFetch=1, after a rollback closed an updatable cursor, rows added or deleted through it were counted but not stored, so freeing the statement freed uninitialised pointers, and adding a row wrote past the keyset.
- After a multi-row fetch failed on a row other than the first of its rowset, SQLGetData() wrote at an offset past the buffer the application passed.
- SQLProcedureColumns() freed the result of its catalog query twice when the query failed.
- In a process named sqlservr (SQL Server linked servers), a server version below 8.4 made the statement parser free a buffer twice.
- A failed SQLPutData in the middle of a SQLSetPos() or SQLBulkOperations() data-at-execution sequence left the whole operation pending, with the internal statement still allocated and autocommit silently off, so later statements were rolled back at disconnect. The next positioned update ran the stale callback against a statement that was never executed and dereferenced NULL.

Most of these can be triggered by a hostile or compromised server, or anyone on the network path of a connection that does not use sslmode=verify-full (the default is disable). A database user who can make a statement fail, or who controls the contents of a row the application reads, can trigger the UseDeclareFetch=1 and SQLGetData() cases against an honest server. The demonstrated results are crashes and heap corruption; code execution has not been demonstrated.

Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

psqlODBC did not check that a server reply matches the query it sent: that a FETCH returns no more rows than it asked for, that each row has the described number of columns, that one query produces one result, and that a COPY, a transaction or the connection ends where the protocol says. By sending replies that do not match, a hostile or compromised server, or anyone on the network path of a connection that does not use sslmode=verify-full (the default is disable) can corrupt memory in the application:

- A FETCH reply with more rows than requested overflows the row cache.
- Extra results in reply to a FETCH, or to the queries of a keyset-driven cursor, are freed while still in use.
- A key query of a keyset-driven cursor answered with extra columns, or a re-read row with fewer columns, overflows the row cache.
- Replies without columns or rows, or with NULL values, to the driver's internal queries at connect time and in catalog functions are dereferenced.
- A malformed relacl value in SQLTablePrivileges() makes the driver write past a buffer.
- On Windows with MSDTC, a long transaction name returned by the server overflows a buffer during recovery.
- Values in replies to the driver's internal queries are used without checking their range: an empty column name, a parameter count, a large-object size, a function's or trigger's argument count, and a result of exactly 32767 columns. They are dereferenced, read past, returned to the application or sent back to the server as stack memory, or make the driver loop forever.
- A reply that ends a COPY, the connection or the transaction at an unexpected point leaves freed results, keysets or table information in use: a CopyOutResponse followed by a lost connection, a ROLLBACK command tag under UseDeclareFetch=1, or a lost connection while a cursor with positioned updates is closed. Eight extra bytes in a reply also make the driver wait forever for a COPY to end.
- On Windows, a start-up reply without client_encoding crashes the driver, and with MSDTC a failed connection makes the XA library use a connection it has already freed.
- An error message ending in the first byte of a multibyte character leaves the SQLSTATE returned by SQLGetDiagRecW() unterminated.
- When a string value did not fit the application's buffer, eight Unicode entry points filled the buffer and wrote no null terminator, so a caller that reads to the terminator, as ODBC allows, read past the end of its own buffer.

This continues the fixes for CVE-2026-120058 and CVE-2026-120060, which covered other replies. The demonstrated results are crashes and heap corruption; code execution has not been demonstrated.

Versions up to and including psqlODBC 18.00.0006 are affected.

The Download Manager plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Local File Inclusion in all versions up to, and including, 3.3.78 via the 'file[page_template]' parameter parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to include and execute arbitrary .php files on the server, allowing the execution of any PHP code in those files. This can be used to bypass access controls, obtain sensitive data, or achieve code execution in cases where .php file types can be uploaded and included. The malicious page_template value is stored when an Author creates or edits a package post, and the inclusion is triggered on any subsequent page view of the package permalink, meaning the include() can be fired by unauthenticated visitors after the payload is planted.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Apache Airflow Pinot Provider, Apache Airflow allows an attacker to control commands executed in the task execution context, without write access to DAG files. This issue affects Apache Airflow Pinot Provider versions prior to 4.0.0. It also impacts any Apache Airflow versions prior to 2.3.0 in case Apache Airflow Pinot Provider is installed (Apache Airflow Pinot Provider 4.0.0 can only be installed for Airflow 2.3.0+). Note that you need to manually install the Pinot Provider version 4.0.0 in order to get rid of the vulnerability on top of Airflow 2.3.0+ version.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection') vulnerability in Apache Airflow Pig Provider, Apache Airflow allows an attacker to control commands executed in the task execution context, without write access to DAG files. This issue affects Pig Provider versions prior to 4.0.0. It also impacts any Apache Airflow versions prior to 2.3.0 in case Pig Provider is installed (Pig Provider 4.0.0 can only be installed for Airflow 2.3.0+). Note that you need to manually install the Pig Provider version 4.0.0 in order to get rid of the vulnerability on top of Airflow 2.3.0+ version.

A flaw was found in openshift-ansible. The installer container's `run` script downloads and executes remote inventory and dynamic scripts without integrity verification. A remote attacker, by performing a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack or compromising the HTTP server providing these scripts, could substitute an arbitrary executable. This malicious executable would then run with the installer's user ID (UID) and full cluster-provisioning privileges, leading to arbitrary code execution.

ChargePoint Home Flex wpa_passphrase Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of ChargePoint Home Flex EV chargers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the PSK parameter passed to the wpa_passphrase endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-29000.

A command injection vulnerability exists in the web-based management interface of HPE Networking Management Software (Airwave). Successful exploitation could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary commands on the underlying operating system of the affected system, impacting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of HPE Networking Management Software (AirWave).

A vulnerability was identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. Affected by this vulnerability is the function Uploads::saveFile/Auth::init of the file src/Uploads.php of the component Authorization Subsystem. Such manipulation of the argument PicoContentEditorUpload leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. This product operates on a rolling release basis, ensuring continuous delivery. Consequently, there are no version details for either affected or updated releases. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

A vulnerability was identified in dayrui XunRuiCMS up to 4.7.4. The impacted element is the function down of the file dayrui/Fcms/Library/Api.php of the component Attachment Download API. Such manipulation of the argument ID leads to unrestricted upload. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Dell Enterprise Sonic Distribution, versions prior to 4.6.1, contains an OS Command Injection vulnerability. An unauthenticated adjacent network attacker could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to arbitrary command execution. This vulnerability is considered critical as it may allow unauthenticated command execution.

Dockhand before 1.0.57 contains a privilege escalation vulnerability that allows non-admin users with settings:edit permission to modify OIDC provider configuration due to an improper permission check. Attackers can send a PUT request to /api/auth/oidc/<provider-id> setting adminClaim to their own OIDC group, gaining full admin access on their next OIDC login.

FFmpeg before 9.1 contains a heap buffer overflow vulnerability in modplug_read_header() in libavformat/libmodplug.c that allocates the buffer using max_size instead of sz. When max_size is set to 0, attackers can supply crafted module files that avio_read() copies into a zero-sized buffer, causing memory corruption, crashes, or possible code execution.
